the plants collected from polluted areas had higher concentration of metals than that collected from unpolluted sites, which is an indication that the heavy metals are accumulated in the plants.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the bioaccumulation of heavy metal elements in the plant samples collected from different places of Kerala State is in the order Al, As, Cr, Fe, Cu, Zn, Mn, Cd, Pb and Hg.
the heavy metal content of Bacopa monneri is not only a function of the soil type, but it also depends on the habitat.
, Bacopa monniera can be used as a bioindicator of soil and water pollution.
